ev.q: MDCHD received a total of 22 reports of persons (four staff members and 18 campers, including the three initial patients)
MDCHD conducted a descriptive, cross-sectional study of the 22 cases
Patients had signs and symptoms including erythema (100%), pruritic rashes (100%), serpiginous lesions (77.3%)
Nine (40.9%) of the patients had lesions in more than one location
MDCHD conducted a descriptive, cross-sectional study of the 22 cases
